targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_email) AS "value" FROM mcp_audit_log
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status='success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / GREATEST(COUNT(*), 1), 1) AS "value" FROM mcp_audit_log
SELECT ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)) AS "value" FROM mcp_audit_log WHERE status='success'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "value" FROM mcp_audit_log WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "value" FROM mcp_audit_log WHERE status='error' AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

panels.title: Live Feed — Every MCP Tool Call
panels.description: Every tool call with user, query, repo, timing, and status. Click column headers to sort.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS "Time", user_email AS "User", tool_name AS "Tool", input_params->>'query' AS "Query", input_params->>'repo' AS "Repo", input_params->>'symbol' AS "Symbol", duration_ms AS "Latency (ms)", output_size AS "Output Size", status AS "Status", CASE WHEN error_message IS NOT NULL THEN error_message ELSE '' END AS "Error" FROM mcp_audit_log ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Users — Who's Using What
panels.description: Total calls, favorite tool, avg latency, last seen

targets.rawSql: SELECT user_email AS "User", COUNT(*) AS "Total Calls", MODE() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tool_name) AS "Favorite Tool", ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)) AS "Avg Latency (ms)", SUM(CASE WHEN status='error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Errors", MAX(created_at) AS "Last Active" FROM mcp_audit_log GROUP BY user_email ORDER BY "Total Calls" DESC

panels.title: Tools — Usage & Performance
panels.description: Call count, avg/p95 latency, error rate per tool

targets.rawSql: SELECT tool_name AS "Tool", COUNT(*) AS "Calls", ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)) AS "Avg (ms)", ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms)) AS "p95 (ms)", ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status='error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / GREATEST(COUNT(*), 1), 1) AS "Error %", ROUND(AVG(output_size)) AS "Avg Output" FROM mcp_audit_log GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY "Calls" DESC

SELECT input_params->>'query' AS "Query", input_params->>'repo' AS "Repo", COUNT(*) AS "Times", ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)) AS "Avg (ms)", ROUND(AVG(output_size)) AS "Avg Output" FROM mcp_audit_log WHERE tool_name = 'code_search' AND input_params->>'query' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY input_params->>'query', input_params->>'repo' ORDER BY "Times" DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: User Activity Over Time
panels.description: Calls per hour per user — see who's active when

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS "time", user_email AS "metric", COUNT(*) AS "value" FROM mcp_audit_log WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Slowest Calls (Last 24h) — What's Taking Long?
panels.description: Tool calls sorted by latency. Investigate slow queries here.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS "Time", user_email AS "User", tool_name AS "Tool", input_params->>'query' AS "Query", input_params->>'repo' AS "Repo", duration_ms AS "Latency (ms)", output_size AS "Output", status AS "Status" FROM mcp_audit_log WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' ORDER BY duration_ms DESC LIMIT 20

options.content:
### Trace Viewers

| Tool | URL | What you see |
|------|-----|-------------|
| **Jaeger** | [jaeger.34.53.165.155.nip.io](http://jaeger.34.53.165.155.nip.io/search?service=mcp-server) | Select service `mcp-server` → see every span with timing, user.id, input/output attributes |
| **Phoenix** | [phoenix.34.53.165.155.nip.io](http://phoenix.34.53.165.155.nip.io) | Click any trace → see user email, tool input JSON, output preview, nested spans |

Both show the **same OpenTelemetry traces** — Jaeger for raw span details, Phoenix for AI/tool-oriented view.
